svg.title: Red Blue
svg.desc: Interpretive vector study after the viewed reference. Approximate geometry; framing, wall, shadows and paint texture omitted. Primary 1973 retrospective colorplate PDF page 77 matches exact 1964 title,90 × 66 in. and historical Hornick collection. Red form rises from lower-left, bows upward and right to touch right edge at about 62 percent height; blue surrounding field retained. Canvas rather than page margin is represented. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of red; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
